tasks.title: Implement errors, events, and models with schema-level validation
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/usermanagement/errors.py with the exception hierarchy rooted at UserManagerError: UserAlreadyExistsError (field), UserNotFoundError, InvalidRoleError (role, allowed), LastAdminError

Create src/backend/usermanagement/events.py with UserEvent (occurred_at UTC) + UserCreated, UserUpdated, UserDeleted, UserPasswordChanged, UserRoleChanged, UserActivated, UserDeactivated, and the structural EventPublisher protocol (publish(event) -> None)

Create src/backend/usermanagement/models.py with the User SQLModel table: __tablename__='users', UniqueConstraint uq_users_username and uq_users_email, UUID primary key (default uuid4), indexed username/email, optional display_name/profile_picture_url, role, password_hash, is_active=True, created_at/updated_at

Create UserCreate with schema-level validation: username ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,30}[a-zA-Z0-9]$, email EmailStr, password 8..128 chars with >= 1 letter and >= 1 digit, display_name 1..64 chars after strip (whitespace-only rejected), role ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$, profile_picture_url must start with http:// or https://; violations raise pydantic.ValidationError

Create UserUpdate (email, display_name, profile_picture_url; None means no change; no username field) and UserRead (id, username, email, display_name, role, profile_picture_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at; no password_hash field)
Export the public API from src/backend/usermanagement/__init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
design_constraints: Field-format validation is schema-level: violations raise pydantic.ValidationError (ADR-023)
UserRead has no password_hash field; the raw User table object is not a service representation (ADR-024)
Events carry non-sensitive data only: no password or hash fields (D11)
The exception hierarchy is rooted at UserManagerError with documented context attributes (REQ-014)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-004, AC-005, AC-006, AC-007, AC-029 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-011, EDGE-012, EDGE-013, EDGE-018 pass

tasks.title: Implement repository: UserRepository ABC + SqliteUserRepository
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/usermanagement/repository.py with the UserRepository ABC: add, get_by_id, get_by_username, get_by_email, update, delete, list_all(include_inactive=False), count_active_by_role
Implement SqliteUserRepository(database_url): auto-create the DB file's parent directory, create the engine, and bootstrap all tables via SQLModel.metadata.create_all (no migration framework)
In add(), map IntegrityError on uq_users_username / uq_users_email to UserAlreadyExistsError with field='username'/'email' (race guard for concurrent creates)
Implement lookups (get_by_id, get_by_username, get_by_email), update, delete, list_all(include_inactive), and count_active_by_role
Ensure thread-safe concurrent use (NFR-004) and per-instance isolation for sqlite:///:memory: (EDGE-008)
Export UserRepository and SqliteUserRepository from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
design_constraints: The ABC is the only persistence contract the service sees; the database must be swappable later (ADR-020)
Uniqueness is enforced at the database level; add() maps constraint violations to UserAlreadyExistsError
Tables are bootstrapped via create_all at repository init (no migration framework, D8)
The repository is safe for concurrent use from multiple threads (NFR-004)
completion_gates: Edge tests for EDGE-007, EDGE-008 pass

tasks.title: Implement service core: UserManager create_user + reads + UserCreated event
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/usermanagement/service.py with UserManager(repository, roles=('admin','member'), event_bus=None); validate the role set at construction: non-empty, each entry matches ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$, otherwise ValueError

Implement create_user: validate role membership against the configured set (InvalidRoleError with role/allowed), hash the password with Argon2id (argon2-cffi PasswordHasher), build a User with a generated UUID and UTC created_at/updated_at, store the email lowercased, store via repository (UserAlreadyExistsError on username/email collision), return UserRead, and publish UserCreated
Implement get_user and get_user_by_username (UserNotFoundError for unknown id/username) and list_users(include_inactive=False)
Decorate UserManager with @logged_class from backend.logging (include_args default False: method arguments, including the password, are never logged)
Publish events only via the injected EventPublisher after a successful mutation; a None publisher means no events and no errors; no event is published on failure
Export UserManager from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
design_constraints: The service references only the UserRepository ABC, never the concrete SQLite class (REQ-013)
Only the Argon2id hash is stored; plaintext is never stored or logged (REQ-004, NFR-002)
UserRead is the only user representation returned by the service (ADR-024)
Email is stored lowercased (case-insensitive uniqueness); username is case-sensitive (D5)
Exactly one event per successful mutation; none on failure or no-op (D10)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, AC-008, AC-009, AC-010, AC-022, AC-023, AC-024, AC-028, AC-030, AC-037, AC-038 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-009, EDGE-010, EDGE-014, EDGE-015, EDGE-019, EDGE-021 pass
Property tests for INV-001, INV-005 pass

tasks.title: Implement service mutations: update_user, delete_user, activate/deactivate with last-admin protection
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Implement update_user: a None field means no change; lowercase the email; an email collision with another user raises UserAlreadyExistsError(field='email'); an empty UserUpdate is a no-op (same UserRead, no event, updated_at unchanged); a non-empty update sets a fresh UTC updated_at, leaves id/username/created_at unchanged, and publishes UserUpdated with changed_fields

Implement delete_user: while 'admin' is in the configured role set, reject deleting the only active admin with LastAdminError (count via repository.count_active_by_role); otherwise hard-delete the record and publish UserDeleted with user_id and username

Implement deactivate_user: while 'admin' is in the configured role set, reject deactivating the only active admin with LastAdminError; set is_active=False and publish UserDeactivated on an actual transition; an already-inactive user is an idempotent no-op (no event)
Implement activate_user: set is_active=True and publish UserActivated on an actual transition; an already-active user is an idempotent no-op (no event)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
design_constraints: Last-admin protection applies only while 'admin' is in the configured role set (ADR-022)
Username is immutable; id and created_at never change on update (D5)
Idempotent no-ops publish no event and leave updated_at unchanged (D10, EDGE-002/EDGE-004)
A publisher exception propagates to the caller with the mutation already committed (EDGE-020)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-017, AC-018, AC-020, AC-021, AC-025, AC-026, AC-031, AC-032, AC-035, AC-036 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-001, EDGE-002, EDGE-003, EDGE-004, EDGE-016, EDGE-017, EDGE-020 pass

tasks.title: Implement password + role operations, cross-cutting contracts, and integration tests
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Implement change_password: validate the new password against the password rules (8..128 chars, >= 1 letter, >= 1 digit; pydantic.ValidationError), re-hash with Argon2id, store the new hash, and publish UserPasswordChanged
Implement verify_password: constant-time verify of the candidate against the stored Argon2id hash; return True/False; raise UserNotFoundError for an unknown id

Implement set_role: validate membership against the configured role set (InvalidRoleError with role/allowed); while 'admin' is in the configured role set, reject demoting the only active admin with LastAdminError; a same-role change is an idempotent no-op (no event); otherwise set the role and publish UserRoleChanged with old_role/new_role

Complete the public API export in __init__.py (User, UserCreate, UserUpdate, UserRead, events, EventPublisher, UserRepository, SqliteUserRepository, UserManager, errors) so the NFR-003 backward-compatibility contract holds
Ensure the NFR-001 performance budgets: reads < 5 ms median, create_user/verify_password < 1 s median in-process on SQLite
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/usermanagement/ tests/property/usermanagement/ tests/unit/usermanagement/ tests/contract/usermanagement/ tests/integration/usermanagement/ -v
design_constraints: Password rules are shared with UserCreate so create_user and change_password cannot drift (ADR-023)
verify_password uses argon2's constant-time verify (NFR-002)
Last-admin demotion protection applies only while 'admin' is in the configured role set (ADR-022)
Exactly one event per successful mutation; none on failure or no-op (INV-006)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-011, AC-012, AC-013, AC-014, AC-015, AC-016, AC-019, AC-033, AC-034 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-005, EDGE-006 pass
Property tests for INV-002, INV-003, INV-006 pass
Contract tests for NFR-001, NFR-002, NFR-003 pass
